links.comparator_used: AI agents appraising guidelines without the structured guideline appraisal workbook (no additional guidance)
links.outcome: Agreement (ICC) between AI agent and human consensus in AGREE II guideline appraisal
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1 ICC increased from 0.613 to 0.709; o1-mini from 0.629 to 0.687. Without guidance, agent-human agreement was moderate (ICC=0.608-0.629). External validation: DeepSeek-R1 ICC=0.711.
links.quote: The workbook improved agreement for both models, with DeepSeek-R1's increasing from 0.613 to 0.709 and o1-mini's from 0.629 to 0.687.
